skins.name: Alien X — Constellation Leak
skins.notes: Helmet, crest, visor, boots and most of the suit untouched; one forearm + its shoulder + a diagonal chest slice are midnight space with three ivory stars (turquoise on the clone).

skins.name: Disco Ball in a Blackout
skins.notes: Smoked-silver armor, plum undersuit, hot-pink mirrored tiles on the shoulders and outer boots.

skins.name: Winning Valkyrie — Final Rotation
skins.notes: Cobalt armor, gold crest, three red wing marks swept back along one shoulder.

skins.name: Ghostfreak — Split Seam
skins.notes: Bone-white panels over deep lavender; a crooked black seam from the visor down the ribs.

skins.name: Feedback — Live Wire
skins.notes: Charcoal + warm ivory, copper fingertips, a thick gold track along each forearm (dark copper on the clone).

skins.name: JJK — Divergent Impact
skins.notes: Midnight school-uniform palette, scarlet collar, rose-pink helmet crown (the helmet stays).

skins.name: JJK — Salaryman Overtime
skins.notes: Sand suit panels, navy gloves, a mustard diagonal strip across the chest; the sword is a blunt ink-black edge with a bright notch at 70%.

skins.name: Kintsugi Aftershock
skins.notes: Cracked indigo pottery mended with gold; one bold forked gold seam on the chest.

skins.name: Midnight Pit Crew
skins.notes: Pearl-white helmet, asphalt suit, orange gloves, a checkered calf stripe, three start lights on the forearm.

skins.name: Woodblock Storm
skins.notes: A moving print: warm paper highlights, flat indigo shadows, vermilion armor, thick black folds; the clone has an offset red print edge.
